name: cavemio-webhooks
title: Webhooks
description: Settings → Webhooks, done properly: "Send test" runs a bead down the wire to the endpoint and back in the answer's colour, and every delivery opens into its request and response.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each endpoint is a button with aria-expanded; its details are its own region. Deliveries are a list whose rows open with aria-expanded, and Request / Response is a tablist that arrows move between.
- The test result ("200 OK in 182 ms") is a status message; adding, deleting, toggling and redelivering are announced too. The wire itself is for the eye only.
- Status codes are told by number and word, not colour alone: 2xx emerald, 3xx and 4xx amber, 5xx and no answer red.
- The bead and the pulse are Web Animations that only run while a test is in flight; deliveries glide with additive transforms (use-row-motion).
- Reduced motion skips the bead, the pulse, the fades and the glides; results and rows still change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: events
props.description: – · Event types an endpoint can subscribe to.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: – · Creates an endpoint: { id, url, events, enabled?, lastDelivery? }. Throw to keep the form and show the message.

props.name: onTest
props.description: – · Sends a test and returns the delivery: { id, event, status (null for no answer), durationMs?, at, attempt?, request?, response? }.

props.name: loadDeliveries
props.description: – · Recent deliveries, newest first, loaded the first time an endpoint opens; before is the oldest one shown when paging back. Return an empty list when there are no more.

props.name: onRedeliver
props.description: – · Sends a delivery again and returns the new attempt. Without it there is no Redeliver.

props.name: onRevealSecret
props.description: – · Fetches the signing secret when someone asks to see it. Without it the secret stays dots.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: – · Turns an endpoint on or off; the switch moves at once and goes back if this throws.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: – · Deletes an endpoint after a confirm.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled endpoints. lastDelivery updates after every test and redelivery.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Every add, toggle, delete and new delivery.

props.name: appName
props.description: "Your app" · The near end of the test's wire.

features.title: Add endpoints with events
features.description: A URL and event chips. A bad URL shakes the field and says why.

features.title: Send test, visibly
features.description: A bead runs the wire to the endpoint, the chip pulses while it answers, and the bead returns in the answer’s colour with “200 OK in 182 ms”.

features.title: Every delivery is inspectable
features.description: Each shows its status, event, time and duration, and opens into the request and the response as JSON.

features.title: Redeliver
features.description: Send a delivery again and the new attempt arrives on top of the list.

features.title: The secret stays hidden
features.description: The signing secret is dots until someone asks to reveal it, with a copy button once shown.

features.title: Enable and delete safely
features.description: The enabled switch saves itself and goes back if it fails. Delete asks first.

states.title: add
states.description: "Add endpoint" opens the form by height: the URL (https://, or http://localhost) and event chips whose checks draw in. A bad URL shakes the field and says why. The new endpoint fades down 6px out of a blur on top of the list, open, with focus on Send test.

states.title: open
states.description: A row opens by height in 460ms; its chevron turns. The first time, recent deliveries load (loadDeliveries) with a spinner, then fade in.

states.title: test
states.description: The bead fades in and runs the wire to the endpoint in 620ms; the endpoint's chip pulses a ring every 900ms until onTest resolves; the bead comes back in emerald (2xx), amber (3xx/4xx) or red (5xx, no answer) in 640ms. Then the status code and the milliseconds roll in, the button says Delivered or shakes and says Send again, and the delivery glides in on top of the list.

states.title: delivery
states.description: Each row shows the status code in its colour, the event, how long ago and how long the endpoint took. It opens by height into Request and Response (pretty-printed JSON); the tab highlight slides 360ms between them.

states.title: redeliver
states.description: Redeliver → Sending → Sent with a drawn check; the new attempt ("attempt 2") fades in on top while the rest glide down, and the endpoint's last status updates.

states.title: secret
states.description: Dots until Reveal (which says Revealing while onRevealSecret runs); then the secret fades in from a blur with a copy button whose icon draws a check, and Hide.

states.title: enable / delete
states.description: The switch's thumb is thrown with a slight overshoot and its label says Saving until onToggle resolves (or is thrown back if it throws). Delete endpoint stretches out of the bin; a check draws, then the endpoint folds away.
